title: Nova Origins
summary: Explore a live sky signal, or preview three investigations across deep time: The Cosmos, Earth & Life, and Human Origins & Civilizations.

details.useCase: Start with something you can see, then explore the evidence behind it: an archive signal, a black-hole calculation, or a feature on an ancient fossil.
details.role: Research interface design and implementation, with a focus on helping visitors read the evidence.
details.progress: The signal field, source map, and black-hole research program are live on Nova Origins. Ancient Civilizations is planned for the main site. You can try its fossil image study here in the portfolio.

title: GOOCI Receipts
summary: Follow a corporate claim to the receipt that supports it.

details.useCase: Make a corporate claim inspectable by showing its supporting evidence and coverage limits.
details.role: Designed the web experience around source-backed corporate intelligence.
details.progress: The public website is at goociusa.com. The portfolio exercise uses a fictional receipt.

title: Hire One
summary: Change a workflow and see how much time its human review takes.

details.useCase: Turn a recurring business task into a workflow that can be discussed in a discovery session.
details.role: Built the discovery website and its intake experience.
details.progress: The portfolio includes a workload calculator with illustrative inputs. Visit gethireone.com for Hire One.

title: My-SLP
summary: A child taps a wagon, watches it go, then matches the picture. Short turns make one word the focus of a speech-practice game.

details.useCase: My Home SLP gives caregivers a way to practice words with a child at home. Animal Adventure pairs each word with a visible action.
details.role: Designed the play sequence and connected modeled words, recording, playback and caregiver feedback in a local-first app.
details.progress: The GO sequence has recorded tablet and phone screens. The POP practice loop also has regression tests. Device and caregiver validation are the next milestones.

exhibit.instruction: Choose a moment from the GO round. These are captured app screens.

states.label: Tap
states.alt: Animal Adventure shows a child and a dog in a red wagon inside a highlighted touch target.
states.text: The outlined wagon is the tap target. Moving it gives “go” a meaning the child can see.

states.label: Watch
states.alt: A hand cue appears on the moving red wagon.
states.text: A hand demonstrates the action, giving the child a model before their next turn.

states.label: Match
states.alt: A wagon prompt appears above two picture choices, a star and a wagon.
states.text: The child chooses between the star and the wagon. A picture match practices recognition separately from saying the word.

title: Real Story Machine
summary: Turn a family memory into a bedtime story. An adult approves the facts and the draft before the Voicebox narration step.

details.useCase: Nova Starbound Stories helps an adult turn a remembered event into a story the family can listen to again.
details.role: Built a review workflow from source material to approved facts, drafts and private audio. The family-voice gateway includes an adapter for Voicebox, an open-source voice studio.
details.progress: Memory Adventure has a private development workflow for reviewing facts, approving drafts and exporting audio. Wider beta access and narrator validation are still ahead.

exhibit.instruction: Choose which detail an adult approves for this fictional memory. Compare the resulting story openings.
exhibit.quote: We followed the puddles all the way home.

states.label: The walk
states.text: “On the way home, we followed the puddles. Big ones, little ones, all the way to our door.”
states.context: Approved detail · We walked home through puddles.

states.label: Add the red boots
states.text: “On the way home, your red boots found every puddle. Splash, step, splash, all the way to our door.”
states.context: Approved details · We walked home through puddles. You wore red boots.

title: Terpenee System
summary: An experiment in how far AI-assisted engineering can take a physical design. Explore the controller for a drying and curing cabinet, from sensor readings to fault handling.

details.useCase: Keep track of temperature and humidity across cabinet zones and examine how a controller responds when conditions change.
details.role: Used AI-assisted design across controller software, embedded firmware, circuit boards and enclosures. Built a simulated cabinet so control decisions can be replayed before hardware trials.
details.progress: The simulator, firmware and dashboard have recorded test runs. The next physical milestone is comparing cabinet sensor readings with an independent reference.

exhibit.instruction: Choose a scenario to see the expected controller response. The image is a capture from the simulator.

states.label: Monitor zones
states.text: The dashboard keeps each zone’s temperature and relative humidity together so a reviewer can compare conditions.

states.label: Open door
states.text: Expected response · HOLD. Opening the door interrupts the controlled environment, so the controller pauses the cycle.

states.label: Missing probe
states.text: Expected response · FAULT. A missing probe removes a measurement the controller needs. The fault record gives the reviewer a place to start.

exhibit.alt: Two simulated cabinet zones display temperature, humidity and controller requests side by side.

title: Civic Signal Minnesota
summary: Find decisions buried in local-government agendas while there is still time for a researcher to read the proposal and its source.

details.useCase: Help a reviewer decide which upcoming local issues deserve closer reading, with the original agenda attached.
details.role: Built a pipeline that reads configured public notices, preserves the source and first-seen time, and produces a daily review digest.
details.progress: The prototype generates digests and records how early an issue was detected. Coverage and reviewer precision are being evaluated.

exhibit.instruction: Choose an item from the project’s fictional municipal agenda to see what a reviewer would follow up.

states.label: Road hearing
states.text: A public hearing concerns a road and stormwater assessment. A reviewer would open the hearing notice to check the date and which properties the assessment covers.

states.label: Utility fees
states.text: The agenda lists a vote on a utility fee resolution. A reviewer would read the resolution for the proposed rate and when it would take effect.

title: Agent Forge Academy
summary: Build an agent handoff and watch a support ticket move through it.

details.useCase: A hands-on way to learn multi-agent design by playing through agent roles, handoffs, and monitoring.
details.role: Adapted and customized the open-source base; reworked the agent flow and monitoring views for study.
details.progress: Base repository recreated locally. Next: custom agent roles and a progress monitor.

title: Career Search Assistant
summary: Compare a job requirement with evidence from past work, then track the application and the résumé used to apply.

details.useCase: Reduce the manual load of job searching by matching roles to a profile and tracking applications in one place.
details.role: Connected a local accomplishment ledger to role matching, résumé review and the desktop application tracker.
details.progress: The desktop app already links matching, résumé generation and application tracking. The next question is which fit signals predict interview outcomes.

title: AI Build Lab
summary: Explore a sandbox for comparing prompts on practical business tasks.

details.useCase: A sandbox to compare prompts and models against real business tasks before committing to a workflow.
details.role: Built the sandbox structure and prompt-testing flow; curating use cases.
details.progress: Sandbox and first use-case set are live internally. Next: side-by-side model comparisons.
